2	name: gravity-ui
3	description: Builds, fixes, styles, and composes UI with the Gravity UI design system — the React ecosystem of @gravity-ui/* packages (uikit, charts, table, navigation, date-components, icons, and more). Routes to the correct package when look-alikes exist, applies theming and required setup, and prevents invented component APIs. Applies when working with @gravity-ui imports, uikit, ThemeProvider, --g- CSS tokens, or any prompt (EN or RU) mentioning gravity-ui, гравити, дизайн-система, компоненты, дашборд, таблица, график, or форма. Also installs required specialized Gravity UI packages when they are absent.
4	---
5	
6	# Building UI with Gravity UI
7	
8	Build UI on **real** Gravity UI components, not from memory. Gravity UI is a
9	multi-package React design system (`@gravity-ui/*`), so the two things that go
10	wrong are picking the wrong package and using an API from the wrong version.
11	This skill routes you to the right package, grounds you in the installed
12	version, and stops you from inventing APIs — match the installed versions and
13	follow the ecosystem catalog instead of guessing.
14	
15	## Efficiency guardrails
16	
17	- Do not read the same file twice. Reuse evidence already present in the session.
18	- Do not dump a reference file wholesale. Use targeted `rg -n -C 4` searches and keep each result below
19	  200 lines unless the whole file is necessary to resolve the task.
20	- Batch package, component, and symbol lookups into as few commands as possible.
21	- Stop documentation research as soon as package choice, import path, required setup, and uncertain props
22	  are confirmed. Documentation is evidence for decisions, not a checklist to read in full.
23	- Do not query unpkg, package source repositories, or alternative documentation mirrors.
24	- Do not install browsers or screenshot tooling, and do not start a dev server for routine verification,
25	  unless the user explicitly requests visual or browser verification.
26	- Run typecheck/build after implementation. If it fails, inspect only the failing API, fix it, and rerun
27	  the check. Do not repeatedly rebuild unchanged code.
28	
29	## Step 0 — pick the right package first (ecosystem routing)
30	
31	Before doing anything else, work out which `@gravity-ui/*` library the task
32	needs. Do not guess from training data — the ecosystem has look-alike packages
33	(`charts` vs `chartkit`, uikit `Table` vs `@gravity-ui/table`, `date-components`
34	vs `date-utils`, …) and picking the wrong one is the #1 failure.
35	Choose from the task's functionality, not only from dependencies already present in the project.
36	Open [`references/package-routing.md`](references/package-routing.md) and read
37	its top **first**: it opens with a task → package decision table that settles the
38	common cases (landing page, dashboard, data grid, calendar, charts, editor, app
39	shell, i18n), followed by the ecosystem catalog with a one-line "what it's for /
40	what to use instead" per package for everything else. Use it to choose the
41	package, then come back here for Step 1.
42	
43	Search the catalog for the task's relevant terms and read the matching package entries. Do not read the
44	entire catalog when its top and those entries are sufficient.
45	
46	Only after the package is chosen, run Step 1 to ground in that package's
47	installed version and API.
48	
49	## Step 1 — ground in the installed version of the chosen package
50	
51	1. **Read `package.json`.** Note each installed `@gravity-ui/*` package and its
52	   version. The installed version is the source of truth, not your memory.
53	   Resolve ranges from `node_modules` (`<pkg>/package.json` `version` field), not
54	   the range string in the root `package.json`.
55	
56	   If the chosen specialized package other than `@gravity-ui/uikit` is absent, add it with the project's
57	   existing package manager before importing it. Install its documented peer dependencies too, then
58	   resolve the installed version and continue with the local evidence below. Do not fall back to uikit,
59	   raw HTML, or a foreign library merely because the specialized package was initially absent. If
60	   installation is blocked, report the exact failure.
61	
62	2. **Fetch the docs for the package you are about to use, in this order,
63	   stopping at the first source that answers your question:**
64	
65	   (a) **LOCAL** — start with `node_modules/@gravity-ui/<pkg>/dist/docs/INDEX.md` or `node_modules/@gravity-ui/<pkg>/build/docs/INDEX.md`.
66	      If `INDEX.md` is absent for this package, fall back to the package's root `node_modules/@gravity-ui/<pkg>/README.md`.
67	      This is the *exact* installed version — always preferred for version-sensitive questions.
68	      Note: bundled docs are a recent addition — `uikit` ships `build/docs` only from **7.45.0**;
69	      older installs have no local docs at all, and that is expected, not an error. Go to (b).
70	      If an import, component, hook, or prop remains uncertain, inspect only its exact installed `.d.ts`
71	      before moving online. Batch all uncertain symbol lookups for that package.
72	   (b) **ONLINE** — per-package llms.txt at the **major line**:
73	      `https://gravity-ui.com/llms/<pkg>/<major>/llms.txt`
74	      (e.g. `/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt` for `^7.2.1`). The major-line URL serves the
75	      latest minor of that major — it tracks the major but not the exact patch.
76	      Use it when LOCAL has no docs for the package.
77	
78	3. **Fallback rule — never silently proceed on a failed or empty source:**
79	
80	   - If LOCAL has no README / `dist/docs` / `build/docs` for the package, or they are empty
81	     → fetch the ONLINE major-line llms.txt (b).
82	   - If the ONLINE request fails — network timeout, DNS, connection refused
83	     (air-gapped / corporate proxy), HTTP 404 (major not hosted), or an empty /
84	     non-markdown body → fall back to LOCAL README + dist/docs or build/docs (a).
85	   - **Do NOT use the `/llms/<pkg>/llms.txt` "latest" alias** as a fallback — it
86	     serves the newest major, which may differ from the installed one and have a
87	     different API. The major-line URL is the versioned fallback; below it, go
88	     LOCAL, not "latest".
89	   - If BOTH are unreachable for a package → STOP and tell the user the
90	     package's docs are unreachable. Do not guess its API from training data.
91	
92	For a bounded local inspection, run:
93	
94	```sh
95	.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card Switch ThemeProvider
96	```
97	
98	The script reports the resolved version, available local documentation, and declaration files matching
99	the requested symbols. Read only the returned files needed to confirm an uncertain API.
100	
101	## Step 2 — implement on the chosen packages, then typecheck
102	
103	1. **Implement using only the `@gravity-ui/*` packages chosen in Step 0 and
104	   confirmed installed in Step 1.** Import from those packages exactly — do
105	   not substitute look-alike libraries (MUI, Ant, plain `<input>`) and do not
106	   reach for a `@gravity-ui/*` package that Step 1 did not confirm installed.
107	   Follow the prop APIs from the docs you just read, not memory; if a prop
108	   you want is not documented, it does not exist — use the documented one, or
109	   ask the user.
110	
111	2. **Apply the cross-cutting rules** in `rules/hallucination-traps.md` while
112	   writing: typography variants, the flex contract, theming/ladders,
113	   `Button view`, `Icon data`. Per-component traps live in the package's own
114	   `dist/docs`.
115	
116	3. **Typecheck before declaring done.** Run the project's typecheck command
117	   (typically `tsc --noEmit`; for monorepos, the workspace's typecheck script).
118	   Fix every error before reporting completion — a type error almost always
119	   means a wrong/invented prop, a wrong import path, or a version mismatch,
120	   which is precisely what Steps 0–1 were meant to prevent.
121	
122	   - If the typecheck surfaces a prop/path that contradicts the docs you read
123	     in Step 1, trust the **installed version** (the typechecker), not the
124	     docs snapshot — the docs may be from a different minor. Re-ground: read
125	     the package's `dist/docs/INDEX.md` in `node_modules` for the exact
126	     installed types.
127	   - If the typecheck is unavailable (no TS in the project), say so
128	     explicitly and ask the user how they want to verify; do not silently
129	     skip verification.
130	   - **Escape hatch.** If the user explicitly waived verification ("just
131	     sketch it", "quick prototype", "no need to check"), you may skip the
132	     typecheck — but state this plainly in your reply: *"typecheck skipped by
133	     user request — code is not verified"*. Do not skip silently.
134	   - **Know what typecheck does not cover.** A green `tsc` proves the API is
135	     real; it says nothing about layout or contrast. Before reporting done,
136	     say so, and either check or list for the user to check by hand: the
137	     screen in both `light` and `dark` themes (text and controls on colored
138	     fills especially), narrow (~375px) and wide (~1400px) viewports for
139	     horizontal overflow, and empty / loading / error states.
140	
141	## Hard rules
142	
143	- **`@gravity-ui/uikit` MUST be installed in every Gravity UI project.** It is
144	  the base component + design-token library every other `@gravity-ui/*` package
145	  builds on; without it components render unstyled. If `package.json` lacks it,
146	  stop and have the user install and configure it first (setup:
147	  `https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/llms.txt`).
148	- **Read `package.json` before importing any `@gravity-ui/*` package.** Never
149	  assume a package is installed; never assume its major version.
150	- **Do not invent props or components.** Before using a component API you are
151	  not 100% sure of, check `rules/hallucination-traps.md` (ecosystem patterns)
152	  and the component's README in `dist/docs`. If still unsure, ask the user
153	  rather than guessing.
154	- **Never guess icon names** — they are hallucinated more often than not. To
155	  match an icon from a screenshot/photo/mock, run `scripts/icon-image-search.sh`
156	  (reverse image search). With only a description, look the name up on
157	  `gravity-ui.com/icons` or ask the user — do not invent one. Then pass it as an
158	  object (`<Icon data={CheckIcon} />`), never a string key. See
159	  `references/icons.md`.
160	- **Theming uses semantic `--g-*` tokens.** Never hardcode colors (`#fff`,
161	  `blue-500`); never hand-write `dark:` overrides. Full token tables live in
162	  `references/theming.md`; the cross-cutting traps (partial brand overrides,
163	  a `ThemeProvider` that themes the whole page, controls on a brand background) live in
164	  `rules/hallucination-traps.md`.
165	- **Required setup is package-specific** (style imports, `ThemeProvider`,
166	  peer-deps). It lives in each package's root README under "Required setup" —
167	  read it once per package, do not rely on memory.
168	
169	## What NOT to do
170	
171	These are the five most common ways agents break Gravity UI code. They are
172	already implied by the rules above; this section exists as an explicit
173	stop-sign. If you are about to do any of these, stop and re-ground.
174	
175	- **Do not substitute non-Gravity libraries.** No MUI, Ant Design, plain
176	  `<input>`/`<button>`, or look-alike component libs. Use the `@gravity-ui/*`
177	  package the task needs.
178	- **Do not invent component APIs or props.** If a prop is not in the docs you
179	  read in Step 1, it does not exist — do not write `variant=`, `color=`,
180	  `name=` (on `Icon`), or a `header-3` variant. Use the documented prop or
181	  ask the user. See `rules/hallucination-traps.md`.
182	- **Do not use the `/llms/<pkg>/llms.txt` "latest" alias as a fallback.** It
183	  serves the newest major, which may differ from the installed one and have a
184	  different API. The versioned online fallback is the major-line URL
185	  (`/llms/<pkg>/<major>/llms.txt`); below that, go LOCAL.
186	- **Do not partial-brand.** Setting only `--g-color-base-brand` leaves
187	  selection, focus, links and contrast on the default accent — a mismatched
188	  UI. Override the full brand token set, on each theme you support.
189	- **Do not override internal markup with `[class*='…']` / ID selectors.**
190	  That's written against one DOM structure and breaks silently when the
191	  component changes. Climb the customization ladder
192	  (global token → component CSS API → narrow flagged hack) before ever
193	  touching structure.
194	
195	## Deeper material — read on demand
196	
197	These files live alongside this SKILL.md and load only when relevant:
198	
199	- `references/package-routing.md` — offline snapshot of the ecosystem catalog
200	  (`gravity-ui.com/llms.txt`), refreshed each skill release. Used as the
201	  offline fallback in Step 0.
202	- `references/theming.md` — verbatim copy of uikit's `docs/theming.md`:
203	  `--g-*` token layers, `ThemeProvider`, branding, custom themes, scoped
204	  themes, `uikit-themer`. The bundled copy may lag — read
205	  `node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md` for the
206	  version-matched file.
207	- `references/layout.md` — verbatim copy of uikit's `docs/layout.md`:
208	  spacing scale (`--g-spacing-*`), `Flex`/`Box`, `Row`/`Col`/`Container`
209	  grid, breakpoints, `useLayoutContext`.
210	- `references/icons.md` — finding an icon by image
211	  (`scripts/icon-image-search.sh`) or on gravity-ui.com/icons; the
212	  object-vs-string rendering rule.
213	- `rules/hallucination-traps.md` — Incorrect/Correct pairs for the most
214	  commonly invented APIs: typography variants (`header-3..6` don't exist, no
215	  `Heading`), the flex contract (`min-width:0`, who shrinks), theming traps
216	  (partial brand overrides, a `ThemeProvider` that themes the whole page, customization
217	  ladder), `Button view` not `variant`, `Icon data` not `name`. Per-component
218	  traps live in each package's `dist/docs`, not here.

184	  different API. The versioned online fallback is the major-line URL
185	  (`/llms/<pkg>/<major>/llms.txt`); below that, go LOCAL.
186	- **Do not partial-brand.** Setting only `--g-color-base-brand` leaves
187	  selection, focus, links and contrast on the default accent — a mismatched
188	  UI. Override the full brand token set, on each theme you support.
189	- **Do not override internal markup with `[class*='…']` / ID selectors.**
190	  That's written against one DOM structure and breaks silently when the
191	  component changes. Climb the customization ladder
192	  (global token → component CSS API → narrow flagged hack) before ever
193	  touching structure.
194	
195	## Deeper material — read on demand
196	
197	These files live alongside this SKILL.md and load only when relevant:
198	
199	- `references/package-routing.md` — offline snapshot of the ecosystem catalog
200	  (`gravity-ui.com/llms.txt`), refreshed each skill release. Used as the
201	  offline fallback in Step 0.
202	- `references/theming.md` — verbatim copy of uikit's `docs/theming.md`:
203	  `--g-*` token layers, `ThemeProvider`, branding, custom themes, scoped
204	  themes, `uikit-themer`. The bundled copy may lag — read
205	  `node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md` for the
206	  version-matched file.
207	- `references/layout.md` — verbatim copy of uikit's `docs/layout.md`:
208	  spacing scale (`--g-spacing-*`), `Flex`/`Box`, `Row`/`Col`/`Container`
209	  grid, breakpoints, `useLayoutContext`.
210	- `references/icons.md` — finding an icon by image
211	  (`scripts/icon-image-search.sh`) or on gravity-ui.com/icons; the
212	  object-vs-string rendering rule.
213	- `rules/hallucination-traps.md` — Incorrect/Correct pairs for the most
214	  commonly invented APIs: typography variants (`header-3..6` don't exist, no
215	  `Heading`), the flex contract (`min-width:0`, who shrinks), theming traps
216	  (partial brand overrides, a `ThemeProvider` that themes the whole page, customization
217	  ladder), `Button view` not `variant`, `Icon data` not `name`. Per-component
218	  traps live in each package's `dist/docs`, not here.
